tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Look up the current weather in a city.

city.description: the city to look up, such as Paris

content.text: A cyclist in Paris will ride 137 km at 23.4 km/h with two 18-minute stops, starting at 13:47. Work out to the minute when they finish, look up the weather there, and tell me whether they should expect rain during the ride.
